assign.outcome:
**Demos never persist silently — the rule is written, the mark is live in six realms, and the pages you make are now real files on disk.**

![](modified-mark.png)

**The record** — [`/imagine/paging/doc/persistence.md`](/imagine/paging/doc/persistence.md): the audit table, the rule, the fs store, and what a page can say as pure JSON.

**The audit.** 9 persisting pages under `/imagine/`, all through core's `store()`. **keep 4** (`team`, `game`, `mag/contents`, `cms/edit`) · **keep-and-move 1** (`paging/make`) · **demote 4** (`platform/topic`, its async twin, every `paging` page, `paging/rightnav`) · **remove 0**. Nothing was removed: each one either saves something the reader wanted or is now visible and undoable.

**The rule, applied.** Three states — *baseline* (nothing drawn) · *modified* (amber dot + a two-press Reset) · *saved* (green dot naming the store). One shared piece, [`baseline.js`](/imagine/paging/baseline.js), two lines to adopt; every page in `/imagine/paging/` got it from ONE line in `Paging.lede()`. The **site-wide reset** lives inside the armed mark (`…or every demo on the site`) rather than on a page of its own — five `lew42:` keys across four realms to zero.

**fs is the default for made pages.** [Make](/imagine/paging/make/) writes `made/<slug>/page.json` through `ext/Saver`'s `FileSaver` (`rpc:write` / `rpc:rm`) — **no new writer**. Proved: add → the file is on disk and the root's `children` names it · reload → still there · `×` → the row and the directory are gone · a cold deep url `/imagine/paging/make/notes/today/` opens six columns · off localhost `app.socket.disabled` is true, the same pages are read from the committed files, and edits go to `localStorage` with the files untouched.

![](make-on-disk.png)

**Pages as pure JSON.** `title` `description` `icon` `width` `children` `index` are read straight off the object by core's `declare()`. A column page, a takeover, a card wall and a rail are **one JSON line each**; a tabs page became one too tonight (`"kids": "tabs"`, built on this seam by the page-builder task). A mag front, a blog section and anything with live controls still need code — the table says which and why.

**Two bugs found and fixed** — deleting a top-level made page silently did nothing (`at(tree, [])` returns a stand-in parent: fine for `push`, wrong for `filter`), and an async `load_all_children()` override throws *"Chaining cycle detected for promise"* unless it keeps core's own `levels <= this.loaded` guard.

**Left open, with reasons.** `/imagine/paging/doc/` 404s (no rendered Docs tab) — the fix is a `doc/page.js`, and `paging/page.js` is another task's fence tonight · `cms/json/page.js` carries the same promise-cycle bug, another realm's fence · four `ext/` modules persist through `ext/Saver` with no mark, and a real head slot on `Page` would put the mark beside the title instead of under it — both written up as proposals with the diff · `made/` is user data in the repo, so stray test pages want pruning before a commit.
